source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
After disembarking, your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units can make an extra **Normal move**.

- It applies whenever one of them disembarks from a **TRANSPORT** without **FLY** whose own move this phase was a Normal or **Advance move**, not counting any that came in from **Strategic Reserves**.
- The extra move is up to D6", or up to D3+3" when the vehicle it left is a **HEAVY TRANSPORT**.

detail.trigger: an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit of yours disembarks from a TRANSPORT

condition.excluding: those that arrived from Strategic Reserves
